player_id.description: Stable NBA ID, never inferred from name alone; null until mapping reviewed.

team_ids.description: Teams during the episode; preserve trades.

excluded_reason.description: Sole noninjury cause; mixed causes need adjudication.

onset_lower.description: Inclusive earliest possible onset; null when unknown.

onset_upper.description: Inclusive latest possible onset; retain whole-day intervals.

onset_date_precision.description: No exact time invented from an event date.

first_public_report_at.description: Only populated when first publication is established.

earliest_reviewed_report_at.description: Earliest found report; not necessarily the first report.

first_injury_missed_game_date.description: Verified first team game missed for this injury.

medical_clearance_at.description: Explicit full competition clearance, distinct from activity clearance.

activity_clearance_at.description: On-court activity clearance, not full medical clearance.

first_return_appearance_at.description: Appearance timestamp, not a clearance timestamp.

last_confirmed_unavailable_at.description: End of observed injury unavailability; not projected recovery.

unavailability_days_lower.description: Continuous documented calendar duration lower bound.

unavailability_days_upper.description: Continuous documented calendar duration upper bound; null if censored.

consecutive_missed_games_lower.description: Verified uninterrupted injury-related missed team games lower bound.

consecutive_missed_games_upper.description: Upper bound only when absence episode closed and all games resolved.

return_gap_proxy_days.description: Local date(return) minus local date(onset), never automatically a primary label.

followup_end.description: Last surveillance timestamp; does not prove continuous injury absence.

label_known_at_primary.description: Latest public availability time of all primary adjudication evidence.

label_known_at_secondary.description: Latest public availability time of all secondary adjudication evidence.

censoring.description: Positive lower bounds can qualify despite right censoring.

episode_relation.description: Do not merge using diagnosis or date proximity alone.

secondary_label.description: At least 10 consecutive missed team games.

evidence_notes.description: Paraphrase, page/paragraph locator and which assertion is supported.
